body:
2 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Spring Bank Lane, roadworks in Rochdale on 12 November 2026 (Rochdale). Rochdale Borough Council lists work affecting Spring Bank Lane in Rochdale; expected timings: 8am–6pm on Thursday, 12 November 2026.

New transport policing command to cover Rochdale’s buses, trams and roads (Rochdale). A new Greater Manchester command brings transport and roads policing together, with more than 60 new officers announced across the network. No separate Rochdale allocation has been published.

Weather: Cloudy 14°C in Rochdale today.
